parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS URLs in regions other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Image format requirements:

- Image format: JPEG, JPG, or PNG.
- Image size: No more than 6 MB.
- Image resolution: Greater than 128 × 128 pixels and less than or equal to 5000 × 5000 pixels. The longest side must be less than or equal to 5000 pixels.
- Image content: Contains 1 to 10 people with clearly visible skin.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

> Image content: If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see [Image resizing](~~44688~~).

parameters.name: RetouchDegree
parameters.description: The skin smoothing intensity. Valid values: 0 to 1.5. Default value: 1.0. A larger value results in less visible skin texture.

parameters.name: WhiteningDegree
parameters.description: The skin whitening intensity. Valid values: 0 to 1.5. Default value: 1.0. A larger value results in whiter skin.
